extracted.intended_audience: short-story authors, magazine contributors, anthology readers, and editors
extracted.subtask_description: Selection guidelines for The Best American short stories anthology: the series editor surveys periodicals and a guest editor (a leading writer) chooses roughly twenty of the best pieces from U.S. and Canadian magazines for publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic/source eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Selected from U.S. and Canadian magazines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each volume's series editor surveys hundreds of periodicals to identify works eligible for consideration; the pool is drawn from U.S. and Canadian magazines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Series editor selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Series editor selects notable works from hundreds of periodicals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The series editor's role is to comb many periodicals to compile a list of notable short fiction (and nonfiction in other series volumes) as the initial selection pool.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guest editor final selection
rubrics_metrics.description: A special guest editor then chooses the best twenty or so pieces to publish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the series editor's notable-works list, the guest editor picks roughly twenty pieces for inclusion in the volume; this final curatorial decision determines what appears in the anthology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guest editor qualification
rubrics_metrics.description: The guest editor is a leading writer in the field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The series appoints a prominent/established writer as guest editor to make the final selections, implying a standard of literary authority and taste.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality aim
rubrics_metrics.description: The Best American series is the premier annual showcase for the country's finest short fiction and nonfiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The anthology positions itself as showcasing the 'finest' works, setting a high-quality standard for selection and signaling that chosen pieces should represent top-tier short fiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Volume size constraint
rubrics_metrics.description: Each volume typically publishes about twenty pieces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guest editor's selection aims to yield approximately twenty stories per annual volume, which constrains the number of works included regardless of the number deemed 'notable.'
